mapper.sql: id, memory_id, patient_id, type, content, source_conversation_id, source_message_id, status, version, confidence, expire_time, create_time, update_time, deleted_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_patient_memories (memory_id, patient_id, type, content, source_conversation_id, source_message_id, status, version, confidence, expire_time) VALUES (#{memoryId}, #{patientId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{sourceConversationId}, #{sourceMessageId}, #{status}, #{version}, #{confidence}, #{expireTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_patient_memories WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND status = 'active' AND deleted_time IS NULL AND (expire_time IS NULL OR expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM ai_patient_memories m WHERE m.patient_id = #{patientId} AND m.version = ( SELECT MAX(revision.version) FROM ai_patient_memories revision WHERE revision.patient_id = m.patient_id AND revision.memory_id = m.memory_id ) ORDER BY m.update_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT FROM ai_patient_memories WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND memory_id = #{memoryId} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_patient_memories SET status = 'superseded' WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND memory_id = #{memoryId} AND version = #{version} AND status IN ('active', 'pending')
UPDATE ai_patient_memories SET status = 'active' WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND memory_id = #{memoryId} AND version = #{version} AND status = 'pending'

UPDATE ai_patient_memories SET status = 'deleted', deleted_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND memory_id = #{memoryId} AND status IN ('active', 'pending') AND deleted_time IS NULL
